publish.description:
Woh call jo aap do din se taal rahe ho. VedicHour aapke din ke saare 18 ghanton ko aapki apni birth chart ke against score karta hai, aur har ghante ke saath ek plain line deta hai - ki woh window kis kaam ke liye theek hai. Kuch windows clearer hote hain, kuch heavier. Sab kuch asli astronomical data se nikalta hai, andaaze se nahi, aur plain English mein likha jata hai.

Apna free chart banao: https://www.vedichour.com/free-kundli?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=launch_video&utm_content=call-karun-v3
Sample din poora dekho: https://www.vedichour.com/sample-report

For reflection and planning only. Not medical, legal, financial, or emergency advice.

v3Notes: Owner kept the HOOK and the apology-call premise; everything else rebuilt under current law. (1) The v2 engine-name line is gone - the same idea now reads 'Asli astronomical data se' in the presenter's own words. (2) Presenter-first: every word is Veo native on-camera dialogue; there is no narrator track at all, so no second voice can appear. (3) Product shot scrolls https://www.vedichour.com/sample-report (18 scored hour-windows, one plain line each), panning 8000->8566px so the 5-6 pm 'the hard conversation, the ask - do it here' window and the 7-8 pm heavier window are both readable; the pan deliberately excludes the 9-10 am card, whose page copy uses off-brand best/worst wording. Never pricing, never checkout, and no free-kundli scroll (that page is a form, not the report).
